{{Top|leg}}
The '''PulseScreen quick-recharge shield''' was a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] system produced by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was known for its limited strength and fast regeneration rate, and later models included an emergency boost that restored a large part of the shield's energy.
